 'A': "a01 a08 a11 a14 a17 a24 a27 a30 a33 a40 a43 a46".split(),

}

kind_of = {}
for k, files in kinds.items():
    for f in files:
        kind_of[f] = k

changed = []

    if todo_text.startswith("bump VERSION"):

    expected_rest = [
        "VERSION = 1",
        "",
        "",
        "def handle(payload):",
        f'    return {{"adapter": "{stem}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}',
        "",
    ]
    if lines[2] != "" or body_lines != expected_rest:
        deviations.append((stem, "body does not match template"))
        continue

    docstring = lines[0]

    if actual_kind == 'A':
        new_text = (
            f'{docstring}\n'
            f'\n'
            f'VERSION = 2\n'
            f'\n'
            f'\n'
            f'def handle(payload):\n'
            f'    return {{"adapter": "{stem}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}\n'
        )
    elif actual_kind == 'B':
        new_text = (
            f'{docstring}\n'
            f'\n'
            f'VERSION = 1\n'
            f'TIMEOUT_MS = {actual_n}\n'
            f'\n'
            f'\n'
            f'def handle(payload):\n'
            f'    return {{"adapter": "{stem}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload, "timeout_ms": TIMEOUT_MS}}\n'
        )
    elif actual_kind == 'C':
        new_text = (
            f'{docstring}\n'
            f'\n'
            f'VERSION = 1\n'
            f'\n'
            f'\n'
            f'def dispatch(payload):\n'
            f'    return {{"adapter": "{stem}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}\n'
        )
    elif actual_kind == 'D':
        new_text = (
            f'{docstring}\n'
            f'\n'
            f'VERSION = 1\n'
            f'DEPRECATED = True\n'
            f'\n'
            f'\n'
            f'def handle(payload):\n'
            f'    raise NotImplementedError\n'
        )

    open(path, 'w').write(new_text)
